articles.title: Real Madrid makes Lautaro Martinez walk past its European Cups before kickoff
articles.summary: Real Madrid made Lautaro Martinez walk through the same hallway visiting players use before competing at the Santiago Bernabeu.
articles.body:
Real Madrid made Lautaro Martinez walk through the same hallway visiting players use before competing at the Santiago Bernabeu.

Along the way, “El Toro” passed a huge glass display containing the European Cups won by the club. The placement hardly feels accidental: before reaching the field, every visitor receives a reminder of the history waiting for them.

Real Madrid does not need to say a word. Its trophies apply the first bit of pressure and can make any opponent feel 1-0 down before the match even begins.
